The formula

Hydrolysed keratin, ginseng extract and coconut oil, split across two sealed chambers — anti-hair loss and anti-dandruff on the shampoo side, damage repair and anti-frizz on the conditioner side.

How to use

Shampoo: apply to wet scalp and hair, massage gently for 2 to 3 minutes, then rinse thoroughly. Conditioner: apply to the lengths only, leave for 5 to 8 minutes, then rinse well.

Key ingredients

Purified water, sodium laureth sulfate, amodimethicone, trideceth-12 & cetrimonium chloride, cocamidopropyl betaine, dimethiconol & tea dodecylbenzenesulfonate, sodium benzoate, glycerin, hydrolysed keratin, arginine, glycol distearate, carbomer, sodium chloride, milk protein, guar hydroxypropyltrimonium chloride, polyquaternium-10, salicylic acid, rice water, ginseng extract, sodium hydroxide, argan oil, coconut oil, citric acid, fragrance.
